description: The agent must: (1) Read project_brief.txt to extract scenario facts: pharmaceutical/biomedical industry (long cycle, 3-5 years), clear application scenario (drug toxicity testing/organ-on-chip), strong mutual trust between Prof. Chen and Zhao Mingyu (4 years in same lab), both want central roles. (2) Consult SKILL.md's decision matrix and correctly classify this as 师生共同主导型 (Co-Leadership Type 3) — NOT teacher-led (wrong: no commercial urgency) and NOT student-led (wrong: professor wants central role). The key proprietary trap is the decision matrix: '长周期 + 明确应用场景 + 师生互信 => 师生共同主导型'. (3) Apply the Type 3 role division: Prof. Chen → 技术研发+学术合作+长期规划; Zhao Mingyu → 商业运营+市场拓展+团队管理; Liu Yanran → business/commercial support. (4) Solve Problem B using the SKILL.md-specific TRL (技术成熟度评估) framework — a generic agent would not naturally cite TRL for tech grounding. (5) Address Problem C by identifying tech-oriented vs market-oriented distinction and the 5-step transition process. (6) Structure the roadmap around SKILL.md's 3 exact phases: 启动阶段, 验证阶段, 成长阶段. (7) Include a checklist covering all 3 SKILL.md dimensions: 团队层面, 资源层面, 战略层面. All output must be in advisory_report.json as a properly structured JSON object.
